mapper.select:
SELECT g.garage_id, g.name, g.capacity, g.sort_order,
ugs.alias, ugs.description, ugs.collapsed_yn
FROM garage g
LEFT JOIN user_garage_setting ugs ON ugs.garage_id = g.garage_id AND ugs.user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY g.sort_order ASC, g.garage_id ASC
SELECT ots.slot_no FROM owned_transport_storage ots INNER JOIN owned_transport ot ON ot.owned_id = ots.owned_id WHERE ots.garage_id = #{garageId} AND ot.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ots.slot_no ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_garage_setting ( garage_id, user_id, alias, description, collapsed_yn ) VALUES ( #{garageId}, #{userId}, #{req.alias}, #{req.description}, 'N' )
